title: Vientiane International Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Vientiane International Marathon review: a record 7,000+ runners from 45 nationalities on 14 December 2025, up 56% on 2024. What to expect in 2026.
dek: Laos's biggest marathon grew by more than half in a year, with a record 7,000-plus runners in December 2025. Here is what the fifth edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: The Vientiane International Marathon is the biggest annual running event in Laos, and it is growing fast. The fifth edition, on 14 December 2025, put a record 7,000-plus runners on the start line, up 56% from about 4,500 in 2024, from 45 nationalities [1]. Poland's Dariusz Bemben won the men's marathon and Thailand's Napatsorn Panthatawewit the women's [1]. If you want an international marathon in a quieter Southeast Asian capital, this is the one to run in Laos.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The fifth Vientiane International Marathon was held on 14 December 2025 [1]. More than 7,000 runners started, a record and a 56% increase on the approximately 4,500 in 2024 [1].

Runners came from 45 nationalities [1]. Lao Brewery Company, through its Tigerhead water and Revive isotonic brands, was presenting sponsor for the fifth year running and provided hydration for all participants [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Dariusz Bemben of Poland won the men's full marathon, and Napatsorn Panthatawewit of Thailand won the women's [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want an international marathon in Laos with a growing field and a relaxed capital to explore.
Growth that fast can strain logistics, so check race-pack and start arrangements when the organisers publish them. Mid-December is the cooler, drier time of year in Vientiane.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Vientiane International Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: A record of more than 7,000 runners started on 14 December 2025, up 56% from about 4,500 in 2024, with runners from 45 nationalities. It was the race's fifth edition.

faqs.question: Who won the Vientiane International Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: Dariusz Bemben of Poland won the men's full marathon and Napatsorn Panthatawewit of Thailand won the women's.

faqs.question: Is the Vientiane International Marathon different from the Vientiane Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Vientiane International Marathon is held in December and includes the full marathon. The Vientiane International Half Marathon is a separate event held earlier in the year.
